column4: cleat#2249: this test guards on CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, which ci.yml's test-go/plugins job sets nowhere (that job's env is CLEAT_TEST_DB/CLEAT_CRASH_DB only, postgres service, no mysql or mssql service) -- so it skips once in this job while PostgreSQL-backed tests run. Dialect-gated, not a hidden failure: the test (plugins/jobqueue/a_v5_payload_not_null_migration_backfills_existing_nulls_test.go) is cleat#2282's MySQL-only regression test for a migration that only has a MySQL arm; PostgreSQL and SQL Server never had the v4 shape it reproduces. Measured by NAME on this job's own run (job 110223348903, PR #2883): exactly one skip event for this test, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL/CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL both unset and CLEAT_TEST_DB pointing at the job's postgres service.
